page.description: Garuda Linux dr460nized image: size, architecture and the publisher's .sha256 sidecar.
page.intro: An Arch-based desktop with its own themes and tuning tools. This entry pins the dr460nized edition, the project's flagship build; other editions follow their own build dates.
pros: Arch base with the project's own BTRFS snapshot setup and tools.
A complete themed desktop out of the box.
Each edition is built and published with its own checksum.
cons: Rolling updates are frequent and expected.
Other editions (GNOME, KDE-lite) are on different build dates and are not pinned here.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Garuda Linux; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One image pinned: the dr460nized build of 2026-10-27, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. The GNOME and KDE-lite editions ship on their own build dates and are not part of this pin.
